name: Parrotmon
main_effect: [On Play] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, 1 of your opponent's Digimon can't unsuspend until the end of their turn.
source_effect: ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)
